prompt:
You are planning a path for the blue circular pusher in the Push-T task.
Image: 96x96 pixels, fixed top-down camera, origin top-left, u right, v down.
State (pixels): pusher at [36.8, 83.2]. Grey T: center [69.8, 58.3], angle -19 deg.
Green goal T: center [42.0, 54.0], angle 45 deg.
The pusher can only push (no grasping). The task succeeds when the grey T covers
the green goal T in both position and rotation.

Return 5-10 waypoints (u,v) for the PUSHER, in order:
- To move the T, first go to the side of the T opposite the direction it must
  move, then push through it toward the goal.
- To rotate the T, push near the end of one of its bars, not through its center.
- When repositioning between pushes, route AROUND the T, not through it.
- The last waypoint is where the pusher is when the T reaches the goal. not insde the goal

tol_px: about 6 px (~6% of image width). Use ~5 px for waypoints
where the pusher must contact a specific part of the T, ~8 px for repositioning.
min_hold: 1 for repositioning, 2 for contact/push waypoints.
skippable: true for all but the final waypoint.
Return JSON only:
{"waypoints":[{"uv":[u,v],"tol_px":float,"min_hold":int,"skippable":bool,"weight":float}],
  "confidence":float,"notes":"optional"}

response.notes: Route pusher below the T to the right side of the stem, pushing leftwards to induce clockwise rotation and translate the T into the goal position.

plan.notes: Route pusher below the T to the right side of the stem, pushing leftwards to induce clockwise rotation and translate the T into the goal position.
